\ No newline at end of file
+    """Parse a human duration string (e.g. "250ms", "2s", "3m", "1h") into
+    integer milliseconds. Raises ValueError for malformed durations and
+    TypeError for non-string inputs."""
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise TypeError("duration must be a string")
+    text = value.strip()
+    if not text:
+        raise ValueError("duration must not be empty")
+    for unit, factor in (("ms", 1), ("s", 1_000), ("m", 60_000), ("h", 3_600_000)):
+        if text.endswith(unit):
+            amount = text[: -len(unit)]
+            if not amount.isdigit():
+                raise ValueError(f"invalid duration amount: {amount!r}")
+            return int(amount) * factor
+    raise ValueError(f"unknown duration unit in {value!r}")
